extracted_concepts.name: Integer
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Whole numbers including positive, negative and zero.

extracted_concepts.name: Decimal
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number written using a decimal point and place value.

extracted_concepts.name: Fraction
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number written as one quantity over another.

extracted_concepts.name: Percentage
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A ratio expressed as parts per 100.

extracted_concepts.name: Ratio
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A comparison of two or more quantities.

extracted_concepts.name: Standard form
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A way of writing very large or very small numbers using powers of 10.

extracted_concepts.name: Algebraic expression
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mathematical phrase containing numbers, variables and operations.

extracted_concepts.name: Linear equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation in which the highest power of the variable is 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Simultaneous linear equations
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Two or more linear equations solved together.

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic equation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation containing a squared term as the highest power.

extracted_concepts.name: Inequality
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A statement comparing expressions using greater than or less than.

extracted_concepts.name: Sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An ordered list of numbers following a rule.

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule that assigns each input to exactly one output.

extracted_concepts.name: Cartesian coordinate system
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A system for locating points using horizontal and vertical axes.

extracted_concepts.name: Gradient
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of the steepness of a line.

extracted_concepts.name: Equation of a straight line
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: An equation of the form y = mx + c describing a straight line.

extracted_concepts.name: Parallel lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that never meet and have the same gradient.

extracted_concepts.name: Perpendicular lines
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Lines that meet at right angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Mensuration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The study of lengths, areas and volumes.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The length of part of the circumference of a circle.

extracted_concepts.name: Sector area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The area enclosed by two radii and an arc.

extracted_concepts.name: Circle theorems
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules about angles and lengths in circles.

extracted_concepts.name: Similarity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures with the same shape but not necessarily the same size.

extracted_concepts.name: Congruence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Figures with the same shape and size.

extracted_concepts.name: Enlargement
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that changes size by a scale factor.

extracted_concepts.name: SOH CAH TOA
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mnemonic for sine, cosine and tangent ratios in right triangles.

extracted_concepts.name: Sine rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule relating sides of a triangle to sines of angles.

extracted_concepts.name: Cosine rule
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rule relating sides of a triangle to the cosine of an angle.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity with both magnitude and direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Translation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that moves every point by the same vector.

extracted_concepts.name: Reflection
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that flips a figure across a mirror line.

extracted_concepts.name: Rotation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A transformation that turns a figure about a fixed point.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A measure of how likely an event is to happen.

extracted_concepts.name: Independent events
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Events whose outcomes do not affect each other.

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The probability of an event given that another event has occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The sum of values divided by the number of values.

extracted_concepts.name: Histogram
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A bar chart showing frequency distributions.

extracted_concepts.name: Matrix
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A rectangular array of numbers arranged in rows and columns.

extracted_concepts.name: Determinant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A special value calculated from a square matrix.

extracted_concepts.name: Statistics
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The collection, display and analysis of data.

extracted_relations.evidence: A percentage is a ratio out of 100.
Standard form writes large or small decimals using powers of 10.
Linear equations are formed from algebraic expressions.
Simultaneous equations are solved using linear equations.
Quadratics involve algebraic expressions with squared terms.
Inequalities compare algebraic expressions.
A sequence can be treated as a function with integer inputs.
Gradient is measured using coordinates.
y = mx + c describes a line on the coordinate plane.
m is the gradient in y = mx + c.
Parallel lines have equal gradients.
Perpendicular gradients multiply to -1.
Arc length is a measurement topic.
Sector area is a measurement topic.
Sector calculations are closely linked to arc length.
Congruence is similarity with scale factor 1.
Enlargement produces similar figures.
Trigonometric ratios are written as fractions of sides.
The sine rule extends basic right-triangle trigonometry.
The cosine rule extends basic right-triangle trigonometry.
A translation is described by a vector.
Reflections can be described using coordinates.
Rotations can be described using coordinates.
Conditional probability builds on basic probability.
Independence is defined using probabilities.
Matrices can represent systems of linear equations.
A determinant is a value associated with a square matrix.
Mean is a measure used in statistics.
Histograms are statistical diagrams.
Vectors can be represented by coordinates or column components.
